contradictionsFound.description: tasks.md marks add-authoritative-history-branches Section 3 'Combat Rewind - PR 3' (tasks 3.1-3.5) entirely unstarted ([ ] on all five boxes, lines 67-71 in this worktree's copy), yet production source on this same snapshot already implements a working combat-rewind commit/preview pipeline that imports and calls the activation/candidate/verification machinery from Section 2.
contradictionsFound.citation: src/lib/multiplayer/server/history/GmCombatRewindCommit.ts:32-42 imports activateCandidateBranch (from EventHistoryActivation), resolveBranchPath, createCorrectionCandidateBranch, verifyCandidatePath, and its module doc-comment (lines 1-27) states 'add-authoritative-history-branches; umbrella 13.5, seam 3b-iv-a' and cites '@spec openspec/changes/harden-gm-two-player-campaign-sessions/specs/gm-combat-interventions/spec.md' -- an older, different change than either add-authoritative-history-branches or adopt-combat-journal-cutover-and-gm-rewind.
contradictionsFound.resolution: Not a real contradiction once traced: the rewind code is wired but INERT on live matches. GmCombatRewindCommit.ts:102-105 refuses with 'no-authoritative-history' whenever `deps.branches.readEffectiveHead(stream) === null` -- and on this snapshot every real match stream IS null, because match combat commands still append only to `mp_match_events` (src/lib/multiplayer/server/DurableMatchStore.ts:158 CREATE TABLE, :746 appendCommandBatch, :802-806 INSERT INTO mp_match_events), never to `event_journal_events` (src/services/persistence/SQLiteService.eventJournal.migration.ts:49), and PR1's genesis backfill only creates a branch/effective-head row for streams that already have journal events (tasks.md:18). So the code exists as pre-wired scaffolding from an earlier change but has zero live behavior until R4.S1 task 1.1 (S1) makes match streams journal-authoritative. This should be surfaced to the roadmap owner as a sizing note: PR 3's domain logic (branch cut, fence, activation call sites) is largely already written; PR 3's remaining work is closer to 'prove it live once S1 lands' than 'build it from scratch'.

contradictionsFound.description: A parallel 'combat journal authority' shadow/parity scaffold already exists (matchJournalAuthority.ts, ServerMatchHostJournalAuthority.ts, and six journalAuthority*.test.ts suites) that mirrors the campaign-side cutover pattern S1-S6 describes, but its mode constant is hardcoded to 'off' and its append target is still mp_match_events, not event_journal_events.
contradictionsFound.citation: src/lib/multiplayer/server/matchJournalAuthority.ts:1-3 doc-comment: 'Combat journal-authority types and consume-apply seam (task 2.3). Flag OFF matches CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_ENABLED.' and line 18: 'export const COMBAT_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_MODE = "off" as CombatJournalAuthorityMode;'
contradictionsFound.resolution: Not a contradiction with tasks.md (task 1.1/1.7 explicitly describe a 'reviewed cutover flag with shadow parity' as future work), but it materially changes the size estimate for R4.S1 task 1.1: a shadow-compare harness (digest comparison, decide/apply/verify/publish pipeline) already exists and can likely be adapted rather than built new. This should be called out to whoever picks up R4.S1 so they read matchJournalAuthority.ts and ServerMatchHostJournalAuthority.ts before writing anything new.
